C1.type: repair (successor control driver with a role column; capability retained)
C1.sentence: At the landing revision corpus/evidence/round94/control-driver-r94.py verify --root . --repo . --rev F --receipts-rev C --work <scratch> prints CONTROL_DRIVER_R94=PASS (exit 0) with COMMITTED_OK=6/6 EXACT_OK=6/6 PIN_OK=6/6 FRESH_OK=6/6 RECEIPT_PINS=6/6, PINNED_FILES=n/n and PIN_ROLES_OK=m/m (n the data rows of the committed pins table, m its non-driver rows), and RECEIPT SELF_PIN OK; PASS requires findings==0, all four row counts full, checked==len(pins), rchecked==rtotal>0, and no role codes. The role column is checked in both directions: role=instrument is exactly the executed instrument set, role=expectation the expectations file, role=receipt the committed receipts, role=claims the round's two claims files. corpus/evidence/round94/forgeries-r94.py prints FORGERIES=PASS FORGERY_REFUSED=4/4 PRIOR_ACCEPTED=4/4 SCHEMA_REFUSED=1/1 SCHEMA_PRIOR_ACCEPTED=1/1 CARRIED_REFUSED=2/2 POSITIVE=pass.

kill_rules.K1: predicate not met at the landing revision
kill_rules.K2: a role forgery accepted by r94, the positive refused, or the r93 projection refusing any of the four fixtures for a reason other than the role
kill_rules.K3: a genuine row moves under the pin walk, or verify writes under the receipts or claims directories
kill_rules.K4: the PASS skips the work: a role leg reading a constant, driver rows counted as covered members, or the role check passing on an empty executed set

named_limits: a coherent joint edit of instrument, pin row, receipt and expectation row survives
driver rows are byte-checked but not coverage-checked: the harness is not a case instrument
roles are membership claims about the table, not about what a file reads
the role enum is closed in the driver: a new artefact kind needs a code change in the same commit

Classification claim: r93 fails both punctuation trees downstream with Q_SHAPE_FAIL=0 and cannot name the class.

kill_rules.K1: predicate not met at the landing revision
kill_rules.K2: a punctuation tree whose shape leg stays green under r94, the positive refused, or DETECTOR_WITNESS not full
kill_rules.K3: a genuine entry moves (located quotes, warranted decision rows or floors)
kill_rules.K4: the new leg is vacuous: it must count the row on both forged trees and stay 0 on the clean tree, and deleting it must change the verdict through the named LEG_FAIL ARITY line

named_limits: Q_PUNCTQUOT counts every three-cell quote row before source resolution, so an unresolvable-source punctuation row also fails FLOOR
the leg shares its expression with the shape branch (punct_quote_cell): a second witness, not an independent detector; its verdict force is the arity tripwire
locates() refuses the class by rule wherever it appears, including a future entry quoting a punctuation-only source
the decision-width print is observability; the WARRANT conjunct is unchanged

C3.type: repair (successor tally counter; tail set bound to owning headings)

kill_rules.K1: predicate not met at the landing revision
kill_rules.K2: the positive tree refused, or r93 refusing either moved tree
kill_rules.K3: a historical, tail or head tally moves on the clean tree
kill_rules.K4: the derivation is vacuous: a declared owner never read, TAIL_OWNED_OK computed from the declarations instead of the observed headings, or the tail compared by count only

named_limits: the owner declaration binds a heading substring; a heading containing the declared string satisfies it (HEADING_ALIAS_ACCEPTED measures this)
the nearest preceding heading is a column-0 line matching ^#{1,6} + space (ATX with a space), not a full ATX parse of setext or indented headings
a tally inside a fenced block that follows a heading is attributed to that heading
the declarations are measured pairs: a third legitimate tail tally must be declared in the same commit
